title: Shaded Beige 3-Inch Center-To-Center Cabinet Pull In Solid Brass, Traditional Style, Cabinet Mount, Allied Brass
body_html:
Refresh cabinets and drawers with a traditional cabinet pull that instantly elevates the room—backed by a limited lifetime warranty — available in Shaded Beige, which offers sophisticated warmth in a soft, neutral tone that complements natural materials and earthy palettes.

  • Shaded Beige makes a bold accent on cabinetry
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your space
  • Make quick work of your refresh with included installation hardware
  • Coordinate your look across the home with multiple lifetime designer finish options

Why it lasts: Solid brass construction outlasts die-cast zinc and plastic alternatives.

Specs

  • Product type: Cabinet pull
  • Mounting: Cabinet mount
  • Center-to-center: 3 inches
  • Dimensions (L x H x W): 3.9 in x 1.6 in x 0.9 in
  • Projection: 1 in
  • Weight capacity: 2 lb
  • Included: Cabinet pull and all installation hardware
  • Material: Brass
  • Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
  • Assembly required: No

Complete your space by coordinating with other Allied Brass cabinet knobs and pulls.
